_comment: Cgroup-hierarchy example. Two cgroups: /background (CPU-throttled to 20% of one CPU via cpu.max '20000 100000') and /interactive (unconstrained via cpu.max 'max 100000'). Each cgroup has two tasks; background tasks are long-running and bursty (5ms run / 1ms sleep), interactive tasks are short and idle most of the time (1ms run / 9ms sleep). Run with -s lavd to exercise the LAVD cgroup-bandwidth path; run with --verbose-summary to see per-cgroup throttle counters.
_run_units: rt-app 'run'/'sleep' are microseconds; cpu.max is '<quota_us> <period_us>' (cgroup-v2 convention).
